implementation_cost.claim: declared cost of the frozen run
implementation_cost.value: One Stage-2 training run only: 3000 epochs x 24 steps x four cards. Sparse context aggregation costs O(nnz(A_batch)d), with nnz bounded by the batch items' frozen neighbor lists; per layer add O(batch_size * code_count * d) hyperbolic distance and rank work, alongside baseline Euclidean code distances of the same order. Frechet iterations add O(iterations * nnz(A_batch)d); cache/reuse contexts within a step. This is an assignment-side overhead, not a second model or run.

prior_work.value: The behavior context is recomputed from current pre-quantization item representations, and hyperbolic distance to it ranks the very same candidate codes used by reconstruction. Unlike a post-hoc behavior loss or codebook-derived context, both signals alter each item's selected code.
